method: 89-night sequential PDCA walk-forward with vectorized bounded candidate generation; existing segment model preserved alongside 100/250/500/1000m zone x 10-minute models

protocol.cycle: predict -> reveal -> score -> add verified night -> retrain -> next prediction

privacy: aggregate metrics only; no dates, raw route/unit ids, coordinates, road names, or hotspot rankings exported
guardrail: All 89 field-evidence nights advance the PDCA clock. Strict road-time accuracy is scored only on GPS+timestamp capture nights after sufficient prior verified capture history. Missing historical GPX is never fabricated.
